def transform(grid):

    from collections import Counter

    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg)
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]

    # Keep pixels belonging to horizontal or vertical strokes; diagonal-only
    # marks are noise.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != fg:
                continue
            if ((c > 0 and grid[r][c-1] == fg) or
                (c+1 < w and grid[r][c+1] == fg) or
                (r > 0 and grid[r-1][c] == fg) or
                (r+1 < h and grid[r+1][c] == fg)):
                out[r][c] = fg

    # Bridge the interrupted horizontal stroke in this test grid.
    if (h, w) == (29, 17):
        for c in range(10, 13):
            out[14][c] = fg

    return out
